description:
Gamille 2.0 Adult Mountain Bike

Step-thru Frame - Easy for riders to get on and off the bike, especially for ladies and short rider.
Dual Disc Brakes - Fully ensure the safety of the ride.

Lockable Suspension Fork - Smoother and more efficient riding experience.
Professional Drivetrain - Provides precise, fast and varied shifting.

Sturdy and Comfortable

This design for lower standover height is friendly for ladies and short rider, allowing them to straddle their bike more easily. GAMILLE 2.0 has a durable, ultralight and preservative aluminum frame which is perfect for exploring mountain trails in safety and comfort.

Seat is widened, thickened, non-slip and breathable. Make you have a longer and more comfortable ride.

Reliable Security

Dual mechanical disc brakes provide you better durability and stopping power. Also, it does not damage the rim.

XC tires are made of non-slip and explosion-proof materials, which has strong grip and puncture resistance.

More Efficient Riding

Front suspension fork absorbs any bumps and dips encountered on your path. When ride on flat road, you can lock suspension fork to reduce absorbing pedaling power.

Lockable suspension forks help cyclists ride efficiently and effortlessly over varied terrain.

Professional Drivetrain

Shimano 21/24-speed drivetrain provides precise and quick shifting with a wide range of gearing, so you always have the right gear for your terrain to enjoy riding.

* For versatility, they are designed as 26/27.5 inch wheels (16/16.5 inch frame), with 21/24 speed options.

Assembly & Guide

85% pre-assembled, assembly tools included, easy to assemble within 25 minutes. NO KICKSTAND. Click on the video to see an instructional video on assembly.

Solutions will be quickly provided by support team within 24 hours! Bikes all have been inspected before package. Solve all your worries!

Step-thru Frame

Hiland aluminum frame is lower so it's easier for ladies and short riders to stand over and hop on and off.

Dual Disc Brakes

Dual disc brakes provide better speed control and ensure full control in every situation. Also, it does not damage the rim.

Lockable Suspension Fork

Lockable suspension fork for efficient and save power riding on flat roads.

Professional Drivetrain

3*7/3*8 Shimano drivetrain provides precise and quick shifting, which gives you more control for climbing, descents and corners to enjoy riding.

XC Tire

XC tires are made of non-slip and explosion-proof materials. It has strong grip and puncture resistance. Dual-wall rims allow them to withstand high-intensity riding and protect the inner tube from rupture.

Conquer the trails with the Hiland Gamille 2.0. Featuring a lightweight aluminum frame, 27.5-inch wheels, 21-speed Shimano drivetrain, and lockout suspension for ultimate control.
